sub_graphs.title: Optimistic Sync: Block Import State Machine
sub_graphs.description: Models the three payload states (NOT_VALIDATED, VALID, INVALIDATED) and the transitions between them during optimistic block import.

nodes.label: Block Received for Import
nodes.description: A beacon block has been received and is being considered for import.

nodes.label: Check Optimistic Candidate
nodes.description: Determine if block qualifies for optimistic import: parent has execution enabled OR current_slot > block.slot + SAFE_SLOTS_TO_IMPORT_OPTIMISTICALLY (128).

nodes.label: Verify and Notify New Payload
nodes.description: Send execution payload to execution engine; accept VALID or NOT_VALIDATED responses; reject INVALIDATED.

nodes.label: Payload NOT_VALIDATED (Optimistic)
nodes.description: Block imported optimistically; execution payload not yet verified. Block root added to optimistic_roots set.

nodes.label: Payload VALID
nodes.description: Execution engine confirmed payload is valid. Block and all optimistic ancestors become fully verified.

nodes.label: Payload INVALIDATED
nodes.description: Execution engine determined payload is invalid. Block and all descendants must be removed.

nodes.label: Invalidate All Descendants
nodes.description: Use latestValidHash to determine scope: invalidate from child of matching hash, or from first execution block if hash is zero, or just the specific block if null.

nodes.label: Remove from Fork Choice
nodes.description: Remove invalidated blocks from fork choice; their attestation weights must not apply to ancestors.

nodes.label: Not Optimistic Candidate
nodes.description: Block does not qualify for optimistic import (merge block without sufficient slot distance); must wait for full validation.

edges.label: Remove invalid blocks from fork choice

external_entities.name: Execution Engine
external_entities.description: Execution layer client (e.g., Geth, Nethermind) that validates execution payloads and returns VALID/NOT_VALIDATED/INVALIDATED.

external_entities.name: P2P Network Peers
external_entities.description: Peers providing beacon blocks that may be optimistically imported.

sub_graphs.title: Optimistic Sync: Security Boundaries and Validator Restrictions
sub_graphs.description: Models the security constraints imposed on optimistic nodes, including validator duty restrictions and fork choice poisoning attack mitigation.

nodes.label: Node in Optimistic State
nodes.description: Node's head block is in optimistic_roots; execution payload not yet validated.

nodes.label: Restrict Validator Duties
nodes.description: Prevent signing with DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER, DOMAIN_BEACON_ATTESTER, and DOMAIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE while head is optimistic.

nodes.label: Validator Duties Restricted
nodes.description: Validator cannot propose blocks, attest, or participate in sync committees until head is fully validated.

nodes.label: Fork Choice Potentially Poisoned
nodes.description: An attacker crafted a block with unreferenceable parent hashes that triggered justification, creating a poisoned fork choice store.

nodes.label: Override with Honest Chain
nodes.description: Honest chain with higher justified checkpoint overrides poisoned store; SAFE_SLOTS_TO_IMPORT_OPTIMISTICALLY provides time window for honest chain to justify.

nodes.label: Node Fully Verified
nodes.description: Head block's execution payload confirmed VALID; validator duties re-enabled.

edges.label: Execution engine confirms VALID for head

external_entities.name: Malicious Block Producer
external_entities.description: Attacker who crafts blocks with invalid execution payloads or unreferenceable parent hashes to poison fork choice.

sub_graphs.title: Optimistic Sync: Fork Choice Modifications
sub_graphs.description: Models how fork choice is modified to handle optimistic blocks, including weight exclusion for invalid branches and re-org handling.

nodes.label: Fork Choice Contains Optimistic Blocks
nodes.description: Fork choice tree includes blocks with NOT_VALIDATED payloads in optimistic_roots.

nodes.label: Compute Head Including Optimistic
nodes.description: Standard fork choice head computation; optimistic blocks participate in head selection.

nodes.label: Receive Invalidation from EL
nodes.description: Execution engine signals INVALIDATED for a block; determine scope using latestValidHash.

nodes.label: Prune Invalid Branch
nodes.description: Remove all invalid blocks and descendants from fork choice; exclude their attestation weights from ancestor calculations.

nodes.label: Fork Choice Cleaned
nodes.description: Invalid branch pruned; fork choice recomputed with only valid and optimistic blocks.

nodes.label: Justified Checkpoint on Invalid Branch
nodes.description: Invalidation affects a justified checkpoint; re-orgs crossing justified checkpoints are forbidden.

external_entities.name: Execution Layer Client
external_entities.description: Execution engine providing payload validation results that drive fork choice updates.

ambiguities.text: When latestValidHash is null vs zero, the invalidation scope differs but the spec does not define what happens if execution engine provides inconsistent latestValidHash values across calls.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the most recent latestValidHash from the execution engine takes precedence; earlier inconsistent values are superseded.

ambiguities.text: The spec states blocks 'may be queued for later processing' when the execution engine errors, but does not specify queue size limits or timeout behavior.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations set reasonable queue limits and timeouts as client-level parameters, not protocol-level requirements.

ambiguities.text: SAFE_SLOTS_TO_IMPORT_OPTIMISTICALLY is set to 128 assuming 'the network will justify the honest chain within this window' but no formal analysis is provided.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 128 slots (~25.6 minutes) is sufficient under normal network conditions with >2/3 honest stake; may be insufficient under sustained attack.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine eventually provides correct VALID/INVALIDATED responses for all payloads.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the execution engine is buggy or compromised, the consensus layer could follow a chain with invalid execution payloads indefinitely.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot prevent the honest chain from achieving justification within SAFE_SLOTS_TO_IMPORT_OPTIMISTICALLY slots.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Fork choice poisoning attack succeeds; honest nodes cannot recover without manual intervention (CLI override of safe slots parameter).

implicit_assumptions.description: Checkpoint sync anchors are obtained from trusted sources with valid execution payloads.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Node could bootstrap from an invalid checkpoint, accepting a chain with invalid execution history as its canonical chain.
